catch_and_ignore_risks: scripts/build.sh reports NOT_RUNNABLE_ENV(headless) for native Tauri bundling because it probes for glib-2.0, a Linux library. On Windows the native build SUCCEEDS, so that branch is misleading here. The real Tauri release build was run directly and produced the artifact.
reason: The release artifact identity is real and live-fired. A genuine 11.19 MB Windows release binary was built with the Tauri CLI, executed as a process, and bound into a six-component identity alongside the real migrations file, built content, generated SBOM, generated third-party notices and the actual git SHA. Verification re-derives every digest from disk and detects a single-byte tamper with an exact mismatch. The SBOM reads 131 installed packages and correctly refuses to invent licenses, surfacing the one attribution-required dependency (caniuse-lite, CC-BY-4.0) rather than waving it through. 10 of 10 mutations detected.
real_vulnerabilities_found: The previous artifact-identity implementation substituted the literal string "MISSING" for an absent file and hashed that, so a manifest built from entirely missing inputs still produced a confident-looking digest. Missing is now a hard error.
The previous implementation bound only four components and omitted the third-party licenses and the build commit, so a license change or a different commit would not have invalidated the identity.

scripts/build.sh's native-bundling gate probes for glib-2.0 (a Linux library) and therefore reports NOT_RUNNABLE_ENV on Windows even though the native build succeeds. It masked the fact that a real Windows artifact was buildable.
known_limitations: REQ-036 requires a SIGNED Windows installer with clean install/upgrade/uninstall. A release binary exists and runs, but no installer was produced and NO CODE SIGNING was performed — no certificate is available in this environment. REQ-036 is therefore recorded as PARTIAL, not DONE.
The build is unsigned, so an updater would be unable to verify it. Updater metadata and the update/rollback drill are not implemented.
REQ-038 (WCAG 2.2 AA with Narrator/NVDA validation) is not claimed. Automated accessibility checks exist from EP-005; manual screen-reader validation is an external human gate (PREFLIGHT PF-017).
REQ-039 (SLOs) and REQ-040 (health/diagnostics) remain partially addressed: EP-008 implements structured events and health states, but no SLO measurement runs against the shipped artifact.
REQ-060 (trademark/name clearance) is a legal judgement with no in-repo evidence; it is recorded as an open external gate rather than satisfied.
The content component of the identity is a single index.html file rather than a content-pack directory digest.
